title: lycopodium obscurum f. foliaceum
intro: Lycopodium obscurum f. foliaceum, commonly known as Ground Pine, is a rare and lesser-known variety of the Lycopodium plant family, known for its unique foliage and medicinal properties. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, particularly in promoting digestion and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Ground Pine include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to ease congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Lycopodium obscurum f. foliaceum include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
